meta.title: About us — a Belgian team finding dressage horses for riders worldwide
meta.description: For 6+ years a Belgian company has been finding dressage horses in Belgium, Germany and the Netherlands for clients from all over the world.

header.title: A Belgian team that finds dressage horses for riders worldwide
header.lead: For more than six years we have helped clients from all over the world find dressage horses in Belgium, Germany and the Netherlands, with everything taken care of.

story.title: Your horse, found where the best dressage horses are
paragraphs: Belgium, Germany and the Netherlands are home to some of the best dressage horses in the world. We work there every day, with a network of more than 800 trusted horse owners and over 2,000 horses to choose from.

You tell us what you need. We prepare a personal selection of 20 horses for your request, arrange the test ride — in person or with remote support — and take care of the vet check, the papers and the delivery right up to your stable.
Buyers who cannot travel get remote support from start to finish. Trainers and sales agents from all over the world can work together with us on the same horses.

why.title: Everything taken care of
ticks: Individual support at every step, from the first question to delivery
A Grand Prix rider who rides the horse for you at the tryout
Full vet check and all the paperwork
Delivery to your stable in your country

cta.title: Tell us what you are looking for
cta.text: Answer 4 quick questions and get your personal selection of 20 horses.
